Lantern Games is hiring a Gameplay Engineering Intern for Summer 2027 in Seattle, WA.

You'll prototype new mechanics in C# and Unity alongside our design team, join
weekly playtests, and ship at least one feature to our live game.

We're looking for people who love games, write clear code, and give and take
feedback well. Show us something you've built: a game jam entry, a mod, or a
personal project.

Pay: $40/hour. Housing stipend provided.
